subject: Request: Sponsored credits for POC surge validation
messages:
From: Jared Moss <jared.moss@glimmerai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Liz Chen <liz.chen@helm-ai.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: POC surge window — need sponsored credits

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from our side: we have a spike test scheduled for next week to validate peak throughput (45k reqs/min sustained for a 2-hour window) and we’re short on trial credits. The test is a gating item for our internal evaluation — without it we can’t sign off on a 3-month paid pilot.

High level:
- Goal: validate 99th percentile latency under sustained burst and steady-state batching
- Window: Tue 2026-07-27 14:00–16:00 EDT (approx)
- Expected token volume: ~3.2M tokens across the window

Could Redwood sponsor a short burst of trial credits / promotional top-up so we can run this validation? We’re flexible on terms (we can sign a mutual action plan or credit use agreement).

Attaching our load plan (glimmer-poc-load-plan.csv).

Thanks — Jared
Jared Moss
Director of Platform Engineering, Glimmer AI
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Jared Moss <jared.moss@glimmerai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC surge window — need sponsored credits

Thanks Jared — and thanks for the load plan. I copied Ben (Sales lead) and Evelyn (Customer Success) to coordinate.

A few quick questions so I can move this to approvals:
- Confirmed test date/time (including timezone): you listed 7/27 14:00–16:00 EDT, correct?
- Exact credit ask: roughly how many trial credits (or dollar amount) are you requesting for the surge window?
- Can you confirm the model variant you’ll use (e.g., rw-instruct-3b-q4 or an open Llama variant) so we can pick the right quota profile?

If we get those answers today I’ll route a short sponsorship note to the promotions queue; Ben will handle the commercial signoff. Evelyn — can you flag any CS-side runbooks or safety limits we should apply for the temporary top-up?

Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Jared Moss <jared.moss@glimmerai.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC surge window — need sponsored credits

Jared / Kimberly —

Thanks. We can approve a one-time promotional credit package for the planned validation, contingent on:
1) Confirmation of test profile and token estimate (I’ll use that to size the credit top-up)
2) A simple MOU (one page) that limits credits to the agreed window and test project
3) Standard safety limits: circuit-breaker at 150% estimated tokens and automatic throttling if latency > 2.5s p50 for more than 5 minutes.

Proposed package: $1,500 in promotional credits applied to your trial workspace, which should cover the 3.2M token estimate at our hosted pricing tiers. If you need more, we can fast-track a small addendum.

If that sounds good, Kimberly — can you route the approval so Finance/Promotions can apply the credit? Jared — please reply confirming the model variant.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Jared Moss <jared.moss@glimmerai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 12:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC surge window — need sponsored credits

Hi Jared — quick operational notes from CS:

- We reviewed the attached load plan. Ok to proceed with the plan as-is provided you run a short ramp (10% -> 100% over 10 minutes) at the start of the window.
- Please use model tag: rw-instruct-3b-q4a for the test — we’ll apply the matching capacity profile.
- We’ll set an automated throttling rule and a one-click rollback if error rate > 2% or 95th latency > 4s for more than 3 minutes.

I attached a short note (redwood-credit-approval-note.pdf) describing the test controls; sign and return if you’re good with the limits.

Evelyn Hart
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
